title: ACTIVE INTEGRATIONS | Enable Chatbot Interactions on a Display or via the Mobile Site
summary: NOTE: Triggered Campaigns must be set up and the Platform integrated with Dialogflow to support ChatBot interactions on/with a Display (raise a ticket for setup support).
bodyMd:
NOTE: Triggered Campaigns must be set up and the Platform integrated with Dialogflow to support ChatBot interactions on/with a Display (raise a ticket for setup support). Once connected to Dialogflow, Brands can synchronise Experiences on Displays based on the Conversational Intent with a Visitor. Triggered Campaigns are mapped to specific Synonyms/Utterances; once matched, Brands can Trigger Campaign Playback on the Connected Display. Steps for an individual Display provided.
